Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is my second Spirit II grill. The first one was great but after 8 years of my neglect and the wet weather in Florida - it finally rusted beyond repair (although one burner still worked). Most of the rust was on the inside of the doors that contained the gas cylinder and around the small wheels underneath. This time I bought on with the ability to hang the gas on the outside and it has 2 larger wheels on one side instead of 4 small ones under the main grill - it seems less affected by the wet, humid weather.  Its also easier to hang the propane cylinder on the outside beneath the permanent  shelf on the right side. Note that only the shelf on the left side folds down. The grill starts up like a champ and with the two burners on high can reach 450° F in a few minutes. It has enough room on the cooking grills to cook enough "meat" for probably 8 hungry people.  So unless you think you will be barbecuing for the entire neighborhood - you can buy this two burner instead of the larger 3 burner.  Overall it's a great, well made gas grill that sells for a very reasonable price. It's also important to know that buying replacement parts and extra add-ons is easy to do either on line or at major home repair stores.
Results.Title: First one was good - this one seems even better

The grill itself is fabulous in every way. Beautiful. Easy to control. Easy to turn on. Even grilling across the whole surface. Love it. 
Do not be misled by an ignorant sales person who tells you that it is easy to put together. I was told that it was just so easy. To simply “…put on two wheels and a handle.” This is patently not the case. It took about, without exaggeration, eight hours and the directions were difficult to decipher. 
I love the grill so much that I almost forgot how horrible it was trying to put it together. It’s better to have the store do it and then find a way to transport it.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill, assembled it, and found out it had a leaky regulator (not a faulty connection to the gas cylinder).  Weber sent me a replacement hose and regulator, but the factory assembled portion of the grill containing the regulator will NOT come off the grill.  Weber's overseas customer service failed to submit the request for the replacement part until I called back several days later to check on things.  When I finally did receive the replacement part, they suggested I purchase some sort of silicone lock lubricant and fix it.  I'm not fixing a brand new grill - it is going right back to the store.  Very disappointed in both customer service and the quality of the product.
Results.Title: Brand New Grill with a Broken Leaky Regulator

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
